status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 42% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 42 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi authorities have arrested several suspected smugglers linked to a boat sinking that killed three children in Erbil and to a child death case in Erbil, while Kurdish security forces also detained a smuggling suspect in a separate incident. Turkish troops have partially withdrawn from the Zilkan camp in Nineveh, and a drug squad in Kirkuk dismantled a trafficking ring operating across the border. A Jewish museum opened in Baghdad and Uzbekistan announced a trade centre in Erbil, reflecting efforts to attract foreign investment. Iran's parliament speaker reportedly met Iraqi militia leaders, and US officials signaled readiness to assist Erbil after a recent missile strike. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske myndigheter har arrestert flere mistenkte smuglere knyttet til en båtforlis som drepte tre barn i Erbil og til en barndødssak i Erbil, mens kurdiske sikkerhetsstyrker også har fengslet en smuglingsmistenkt i en separat hendelse. Tyrkiske tropper har delvis trukket seg tilbake fra Zilkan-leiren i Nineveh, og en narkotikagruppe i Kirkuk har avviklet et smuglernettverk som opererte over grensen. Et jødisk museum åpnet i Bagdad og Usbekistan kunngjorde et handelssenter i Erbil, noe som reflekterer forsøk på å tiltrekke utenlandske investeringer. Iraks parlamentarsjef skal ha møtt irakiske militsledere, og amerikanske tjenestemenn signaliserte beredskap til å bistå Erbil etter et nylig missilangrep. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
